0.original: Concern is writ plain upon Vuyargur's face.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Speak with the Yok Huy supply runner at Icuvlo's Inn.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I have a favor to ask of you. I had sent someone to Icuvlo's Inn to replenish our larder, but she is rather late to return.

49.original: I fear she may have encountered some manner of trouble on the road. I would be grateful if you could search for her.

50.original: Oh dear, Vuyargur asked you to find me? I'm so sorry, I didn't mean to make him worry.

51.original: I'd heard that a feast was to be held for the snow spirits, you see, and I wanted to serve up something that they might enjoy with the kirkahryar.

52.original: But I couldn't think of anything, and the time got away... Would you happen to have any ideas?

53.original: I wanted to provide a treat for the spirits again─something different and new. But I couldn't think of anything, and the time got away... Would you happen to have any ideas?

55.original: How about another variety of liquor?

56.original: How about sweets prepared with ice?

57.original: There's no knowing the spirits' tastes.

58.original: Ah, so something that offers contrast. In which case, the Pelupelu's mezcal may be suitable.

59.original: The taste is rather different from kirkahryar, but perhaps some snow spirits will enjoy it.

60.original: Ah, of course, it stands to reason that snow spirits would prefer cold things.

61.original: In which case, perhaps I could freeze some flowers and fruits in a bed of ice. That would be both pretty and palatable, I daresay.

62.original: It's true, there's still much that we don't know about the spirits... That's why I spent so much time pondering it to no avail.

63.original: Perhaps by simply enjoying the occasion ourselves, we would make it more enjoyable for them. In which case, something that we ourselves like would be suitable.

64.original: Yes, the more I think on it, the more I feel confident in that approach. It will make for a wonderful banquet, I'm sure of it!

65.original: I'm much obliged for your guidance. Please assure Vuyargur that I'll be back as soon as I have what I need.

66.original: My thanks again for your guidance, and please assure Vuyargur that I'll be back as soon as I have what I need.

67.original: Were you able to find the supply runner?

68.original: So that is the way of it... I'm glad to hear that she was safe.

69.original: And thanks to your sage counsel, she was able to arrive at an answer to her dilemma. I shall look forward to seeing what she acquires for the snow spirits.
